title: Asmodensius-Native: Freestanding C23, AVX-VNNI, and Pure-Integer PTX Artificial-Life Engine with 6-Kernel Lean 4.35.0 Formal Invariants
description: Windows-native freestanding C23 artificial-life simulation engine (22 core modules, 4 NASM AVX2/AVX-VNNI twins, 41,817 B pure-integer CUDA PTX backend, exact integer matter/energy conservation, 77/77 CTest, 164/164 GPU differential checks) with a 30-theorem 6-kernel Palomar-ready Pure Lean 4.35.0 formal proof suite and AMS-LaTeX white paper. Independent research preprint; not peer-reviewed; 0/1,900 Mega-Atlas open problems retired.
notes: Dual-licensed: Apache-2.0 for code, Lean 4 proofs, and scripts; CC-BY-4.0 for white paper, figures, documentation, and datasets. AI coding assistants assisted with implementation iterations, Lean refactoring, and documentation under human review and automated kernel/CTest verification.
